name: PlannedOutageNotificationPlanner
tagline: Plan interruptions, hit every notice deadline and protect life-support customers.
description: A complete planned-outage app for electricity, gas and water networks: outage requests with affected, commercial and life-support customers, notice-period deadlines in business days, feeder clash and blackout checks, an approval checklist, customer notice text with SMS counter, a drag-and-drop feeder calendar and a public outage lookup.
features: Notice deadline engine (business/calendar days, life-support period)
Feeder clash, blackout date and maximum-window rules
Approval checklist with independent approver for major outages
Customer notice template with SMS segments, copy and send-via-flow
Bulk actions, CSV export and undo
controlType: standard (2 controls: PlannedOutageNotificationPlanner data-set + PlannedOutageNotificationPlannerPortal field control)
